name: Loop wraith
description: a hooded wraith of Hell's loop: a floating ragged shroud of pale cyan mist with no body inside, the shroud's folds drawn into a looping spiral, a ring of faint ghostly clock hands turning in its empty hood, two pale cyan eyes, the background visible through it

poses.stand: floating upright, its misty shroud trailing into a loop at the bottom, the ghostly clock hands turning in its hood
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: unravelling into a spiral of pale cyan mist and fading clock hands

idle.action: floats, its shroud curling round and round into the same loop, the clock hands ticking

attack.action: spreads its misty sleeves and spits a pale cyan ember forward to the right, the clock hands in its hood spinning

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
